AllocateCostUnitResource.title: AllocateCostUnitResource
AllocateCostUnitResource.summary: Transfers resource instances from the source cost center to the destination cost center.

ConfirmRelation.title: ConfirmRelation
ConfirmRelation.summary: Confirms an invitation from an Alibaba Cloud account.

ConvertChargeType.title: ConvertChargeType
ConvertChargeType.summary: Changes the billing method for an instance. You can convert Server Load Balancer (SLB), elastic IP addresses (EIPs), and NAT Gateway instances from pay-as-you-go to subscription. You can also convert SLB and EIP instances from subscription to pay-as-you-go.

CreateCostUnit.title: CreateCostUnit
CreateCostUnit.summary: Creates one or more cost centers.

CreateInstance.title: CreateInstance
CreateInstance.summary: Creates an instance. If you call this operation, an order for a new instance is created and the order is automatically paid for. You cannot create Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances or ApsaraDB RDS instances by calling the operation.

CreateResellerUserQuota.title: CreateResellerUserQuota
CreateResellerUserQuota.summary: Creates a user quota ledger and a quota consumption ledger.

DescribeCostBudgetsSummary.title: DescribeCostBudgetsSummary
DescribeCostBudgetsSummary.summary: Queries a summary of cost budgets.

DescribeInstanceAmortizedCostByAmortizat.title: DescribeInstanceAmortizedCostByAmortizationPeriod
DescribeInstanceAmortizedCostByAmortizat.summary: Queries the monthly amortized costs of instances for a specified amortization month.

DescribeInstanceAmortizedCostByConsumePe.title: DescribeInstanceAmortizedCostByConsumePeriod
DescribeInstanceAmortizedCostByConsumePe.summary: Queries the monthly amortized cost of an instance by billing cycle.

DescribeInstanceBill.title: DescribeInstanceBill
DescribeInstanceBill.summary: Queries the consumption summary of all product instances or billable items for an account within a billing cycle.

DescribePricingModule.title: Query product module information
DescribePricingModule.summary: Queries the module information of a specified Alibaba Cloud product.

DescribeProductAmortizedCostByAmortizati.title: DescribeProductAmortizedCostByAmortizationPeriod
DescribeProductAmortizedCostByAmortizati.summary: Queries the monthly amortized cost of products for a specified month.

DescribeProductAmortizedCostByConsumePer.title: DescribeProductAmortizedCostByConsumePeriod
DescribeProductAmortizedCostByConsumePer.summary: Queries the monthly amortized cost of a product for a specific billing cycle.

DescribeResourceCoverageDetail.title: DescribeResourceCoverageDetail
DescribeResourceCoverageDetail.summary: Queries the coverage details of reserved instances (RIs) or storage capacity units (SCUs).

DescribeResourceCoverageTotal.title: DescribeResourceCoverageTotal
DescribeResourceCoverageTotal.summary: Queries the total coverage data of reserved instances (RIs) or storage capacity units (SCUs).

DescribeResourcePackageProduct.title: DescribeResourcePackageProduct
DescribeResourcePackageProduct.summary: Queries the information about resource plans of an Alibaba Cloud service.

DescribeResourceUsageDetail.title: DescribeResourceUsageDetail
DescribeResourceUsageDetail.summary: Queries the usage details of reserved instances (RIs) or storage capacity units (SCUs).

DescribeResourceUsageTotal.title: DescribeResourceUsageTotal
DescribeResourceUsageTotal.summary: Queries the total usage data of reserved instances or storage capacity units (SCUs).

DescribeSavingsPlansCoverageDetail.title: DescribeSavingsPlansCoverageDetail
DescribeSavingsPlansCoverageDetail.summary: Queries detailed information about savings plan coverage.

DescribeSavingsPlansCoverageTotal.title: DescribeSavingsPlansCoverageTotal
DescribeSavingsPlansCoverageTotal.summary: Queries the total coverage of savings plans.

DescribeSavingsPlansUsageDetail.title: DescribeSavingsPlansUsageDetail
DescribeSavingsPlansUsageDetail.summary: Queries the usage details of savings plans.

DescribeSavingsPlansUsageTotal.title: DescribeSavingsPlansUsageTotal
DescribeSavingsPlansUsageTotal.summary: Queries the total usage of savings plans.

GetAccountRelation.title: GetAccountRelation
GetAccountRelation.summary: Queries the details of a financial relationship.

GetCustomerAccountInfo.title: Query partner customer account information
GetCustomerAccountInfo.summary: Queries the account information of an end customer under a partner.

GetCustomerList.title: Query sub-account list
GetCustomerList.summary: Queries the list of end customer UIDs under a partner.

GetOrderDetail.title: GetOrderDetail
GetOrderDetail.summary: Queries the details of an order that belongs to your Alibaba Cloud account or distributors.

GetPayAsYouGoPrice.title: GetPayAsYouGoPrice
GetPayAsYouGoPrice.summary: Queries the prices of pay-as-you-go products.

GetResourcePackagePrice.title: GetResourcePackagePrice
GetResourcePackagePrice.summary: Queries the price of a resource plan.

GetSubscriptionPrice.title: GetSubscriptionPrice
GetSubscriptionPrice.summary: This operation queries the price of a subscription product.

InquiryPriceRefundInstance.title: Query refund price for instance unsubscription
InquiryPriceRefundInstance.summary: Queries the refund amount for an instance that you want to unsubscribe from.

ModifyAccountRelation.title: ModifyAccountRelation
ModifyAccountRelation.summary: Adds or deletes permissions for an account linking relationship.

ModifyCostUnit.title: ModifyCostUnit
ModifyCostUnit.summary: Modifies one or more cost centers.

ModifyInstance.title: ModifyInstance
ModifyInstance.summary: Modifies the configuration of an instance resource. Calling this operation creates an order to modify the instance configuration and automatically completes the payment. This operation does not support configuration changes for ECS or RDS products. To do so, call the product-specific API operation instead.

QueryAccountBill.title: QueryAccountBill
QueryAccountBill.summary: Queries account spending within a billing cycle and aggregates the data by resource owner.

QueryAccountTransactionDetails.title: QueryAccountTransactionDetails
QueryAccountTransactionDetails.summary: Queries the details of account transactions (income and expenditure).

QueryAccountTransactions.title: QueryAccountTransactions
QueryAccountTransactions.summary: Queries transactions within your Alibaba Cloud account.

QueryBill.title: Query settlement bills
QueryBill.summary: Queries the settlement bills of a user within a specific billing cycle.

QueryBillOverview.title: Query bill overview
QueryBillOverview.summary: Queries the bill overview of a user for a specific billing cycle.

QueryBillToOSSSubscription.title: QueryBillToOSSSubscription
QueryBillToOSSSubscription.summary: Queries the subscribed bills that are stored in Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket.

QueryCommodityList.title: Query commodity information list by product code
QueryCommodityList.summary: Retrieves a list of commodity information based on a product code.

QueryCostUnit.title: QueryCostUnit
QueryCostUnit.summary: Queries all cost centers within the current node of the cost center tree. If the ParentUnitId parameter is set to -1, all cost centers are queried.

QueryCostUnitResource.title: QueryCostUnitResource
QueryCostUnitResource.summary: Queries the resource instances that are allocated to a cost center. If the unitId parameter is set to 0, the unallocated primary resource instances and sub-resource instances are queried.

QueryCustomerAddressList.title: QueryCustomerAddressList
QueryCustomerAddressList.summary: Queries the mailing addresses for Alibaba Cloud invoices.

QueryDPUtilizationDetail.title: QueryDPUtilizationDetail
QueryDPUtilizationDetail.summary: Queries the usage of resource plans, including reserved instances (RIs) and storage capacity units (SCUs).

QueryEvaluateList.title: QueryEvaluateList
QueryEvaluateList.summary: Queries a list of objects that are eligible for invoicing.

QueryFinancialAccountInfo.title: QueryFinancialAccountInfo
QueryFinancialAccountInfo.summary: Queries the financial information of an enterprise account that is part of a management-member relationship.

QueryInstanceBill.title: QueryInstanceBill
QueryInstanceBill.summary: Queries the usage summary of all product instances or billable items for an account in a billing cycle. This operation has been upgraded to DescribeInstanceBill. This operation no longer queries data beyond the 50,000th row.

QueryInstanceByTag.title: QueryInstanceByTag
QueryInstanceByTag.summary: Queries a list of instances by tags.

QueryInstanceGaapCost.title: Query monthly cost allocation service
QueryInstanceGaapCost.summary: This API is deprecated. Use the following APIs to retrieve the amortized cost: `DescribeInstanceAmortizedCostByAmortizationPeriod` - retrieves instance costs by amortization period; `DescribeProductAmortizedCostByAmortizationPeriod` - retrieves product costs by amortization period; `DescribeInstanceAmortizedCostByConsumePeriod` - retrieves instance costs by consume period; `DescribeProductAmortizedCostByConsumePeriod` - retrieves product costs by consume period.

QueryInvoicingCustomerList.title: QueryInvoicingCustomerList
QueryInvoicingCustomerList.summary: Queries the invoicing information of an Alibaba Cloud user.

QueryOrders.title: QueryOrders
QueryOrders.summary: Queries the orders of a user or a distribution customer. By default, the query returns orders created within the last hour. To query orders over a longer period, set the CreateTimeStart and CreateTimeEnd parameters.

QueryPermissionList.title: QueryPermissionList
QueryPermissionList.summary: Queries the permissions for a master-member relationship based on the relationship ID.

QueryPrepaidCards.title: QueryPrepaidCards
QueryPrepaidCards.summary: Queries information about a user's prepaid cards.

QueryPriceEntityList.title: List pricing entities of a commodity
QueryPriceEntityList.summary: Queries the pricing entities under a commodity. A pricing entity is the smallest product capability used for metering and cost calculation.

QueryProductList.title: Query product information
QueryProductList.summary: Queries the list of products available for the current account to order. The response includes the product code, product name, and subscription type (subscription or pay-as-you-go).

QueryRIUtilizationDetail.title: QueryRIUtilizationDetail
QueryRIUtilizationDetail.summary: Queries the usage details of a reserved instance (RI).

QueryRedeem.title: QueryRedeem
QueryRedeem.summary: Queries the information about a voucher.

QueryRelationList.title: QueryRelationList
QueryRelationList.summary: Queries a list of the relationships of member accounts.

QueryResellerAvailableQuota.title: QueryResellerAvailableQuota
QueryResellerAvailableQuota.summary: Queries the available quota for a user in a reseller payment scenario.

QueryResourcePackageInstances.title: QueryResourcePackageInstances
QueryResourcePackageInstances.summary: Queries the instances of a resource plan. You can query the resource plans that are valid.

QuerySavingsPlansDeductLog.title: QuerySavingsPlansDeductLog
QuerySavingsPlansDeductLog.summary: Queries the details of savings plan deductions.

QuerySavingsPlansDiscount.title: QuerySavingsPlansDiscount
QuerySavingsPlansDiscount.summary: Queries the discount information for savings plans.

QuerySavingsPlansInstance.title: QuerySavingsPlansInstance
QuerySavingsPlansInstance.summary: Queries information about your savings plan instances.

QuerySettleBill.title: Query settlement bills
QuerySettleBill.summary: Queries the settlement bills of a user for a specific billing cycle. Supports domestic accounts with more than 50,000 bill entries.

QuerySkuPriceList.title: Query SKU list under a commodity pricing entity
QuerySkuPriceList.summary: Queries the SKU list and list prices under a specified pricing entity of a commodity. A product feature typically has 1 to multiple SKUs, and some products may have tens of thousands of SKUs. The request parameters support filtered queries based on specific SKU configuration conditions.

QuerySplitItemBill.title: QuerySplitItemBill
QuerySplitItemBill.summary: Queries split bills. This API has been upgraded. We recommend that you use the new DescribeSplitItemBill operation.

QueryUserOmsData.title: QueryUserOmsData
QueryUserOmsData.summary: Queries the metering records for a specified cloud product.

RefundInstance.title: Unsubscribe from an instance
RefundInstance.summary: Unsubscribes from an instance that is no longer needed.

ReleaseInstance.title: ReleaseInstance
ReleaseInstance.summary: Releases instances by Virtual Network Operators (VNOs).

RelieveAccountRelation.title: RelieveAccountRelation
RelieveAccountRelation.summary: Disassociates a RAM user from an Alibaba Cloud account.

RenewChangeInstance.title: RenewChangeInstance
RenewChangeInstance.summary: Renews an instance and changes its configuration. The configuration change is applied after the renewal order takes effect. Payment is processed automatically. This operation cannot be used to create ECS or RDS instances.

RenewInstance.title: RenewInstance
RenewInstance.summary: Renews a specified instance. This operation cannot be used to renew ECS, RDS, or Redis instances. To renew these instances, call the dedicated renewal API for the specific product.

SetAllExpirationDay.title: SetAllExpirationDay
SetAllExpirationDay.summary: Sets an expiration date for all Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances.

SetResellerUserQuota.title: Modify the quota ledger and consumption ledger.
SetResellerUserQuota.summary: Modify the quota ledger and consumption ledger.

SetResellerUserStatus.title: SetResellerUserStatus
SetResellerUserStatus.summary: Enables or disables the SQL audit feature for users.

SubscribeBillToOSS.title: SubscribeBillToOSS
SubscribeBillToOSS.summary: Subscribes to bill files and stores the bill data in a specified Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket.

UnsubscribeBillToOSS.title: UnsubscribeBillToOSS
UnsubscribeBillToOSS.summary: Unsubscribes from the detailed bill export service.
